style.components: one reusable component per widget kind, configured by props
style.state: one createStore for the whole dashboard, shared through a context; widgets use path setters on their slice
style.externalEvents: store.receive(msg); serverSet and snapshot through reconcile(…, { key: 'id' })
style.derived: plain functions; createMemo for the filtered list
style.events: onClick/onInput (delegated), onChange for checkboxes and selects
style.build: Vite + vite-plugin-solid, production defaults, hidden source maps

style.architecture: TEA with Browser.element: one Model record (a field per widget), one update, one view
style.components: shared components: one module per widget kind (Model, Msg, Config, update, view, decoder), written once; per widget only a Config value, a Model field and a Msg constructor wrapping its kind's Msg, routed in update, the decoders and view (Html.map)
style.configuration: a Config record per widget; rules and formats built with the kind module's helpers (Field.required/minLength/matching, Amount.currency/percent/unit)
style.externalEvents: one incoming port; Json.Decode into the app's messages (serverSet → the widget's Replaced, notify → Feed.Notified, tick → Tick, snapshot → GotSnapshot)
style.lists: Html.Keyed for todo, filter and feed
style.derived: computed in view (summary lines, todo left, filter matches)
style.events: onInput for text inputs and the select, onClick for buttons and checkboxes, a number-only input decoder for the amount
style.formatting: as elm-format 0.8.8 writes it; clean under elm-review's NoUnused, Simplify and elm-review-common rules (exposing lists and elm.json dependencies limited to what the app uses)
style.build: elm make --optimize, then uglify-js compress (pure_funcs) and mangle passes, as the Elm guide recommends

style.components: one module per widget kind (message tags, reducer, DOM factory), configured per widget
style.state: each instance's model in its own closure; send(tag, value) runs the kind's reducer arm for that tag and schedules that instance's binding list
style.updates: one patch function per instance, every DOM write skipped when unchanged; batched in a microtask
style.crossWidget: summaries watch the instances they read and recompute when one changes
style.externalEvents: serverSet/snapshot replace instance models; tick and notify are messages to clock and feed instances
style.lists: runtime keyed list by item.id: patch changed rows, one forward placement pass when order or membership changes
style.conditionals: node built once, attached while shown
style.events: addEventListener per element: click for buttons and checkboxes, input for text and number inputs and selects (as the unique widgets' wire)
style.build: Vite production build, no framework plugin, hidden source maps

style.track: prototype: no framework implements this strategy
style.components: one factory per widget kind, called with each widget's arguments positionally; DOM built once with createElement
style.messages: erased for DOM events: each update arm is an action that writes model fields in place
style.updates: each action schedules the bindings that read the fields it writes (known at compile time); one microtask flush
style.derived: summaries subscribe once to their sources' readers; sources schedule them when they write a field a summary reads
style.lists: keyed: in-place edits schedule only their rows (add, remove) or the row's binding (toggle); replaced or derived arrays reconcile by id in one forward pass
style.externalEvents: receive(msg): serverSet and snapshot replace a widget's state and run all its bindings; tick and notify call the widget's external arms
style.build: Vite with no framework plugin, production defaults, hidden source maps

style.components: one module per widget kind (reducer + DOM factory), configured per widget by a plain object
style.state: one immutable TEA model; the app reducer routes messages to the widgets' reducers
style.updates: reducers are tables of arms by message tag; each arm returns the compile-time dirty bits of the fields it writes with the new slice; a static patch per kind runs only the bindings whose bits are set, batched in a microtask
style.externalEvents: through the same reducer (send); serverSet and snapshot mark every bit of the widgets they replace
style.lists: keyed by id: changed rows patched, gone rows removed, misplaced nodes moved in one walk
style.conditionals: built once with the template, swapped for an empty comment while hidden
style.derived: summaries recomputed when a dirty bit they read is set (static dependencies)
style.events: addEventListener on each element, sending a message (numeric tags) built when wired, or carrying the control's value
style.build: Vite with no framework plugin, production defaults, hidden source maps

style.approach: compiled dirty checking, per widget: an event re-runs the bindings of the widget it touched (and of the summaries reading it), writing a DOM property only when its value changed
style.components: one factory per widget kind present in the app; one data row per instance, the labels in a table of their own
style.state: plain mutable variables of the kind's factory, one set per widget; external replacements go through a setter the factory hands the runtime; a feed's entries sit on a record notify pushes into
style.templates: HTML strings with the instance's constants (escaped at build time), no end tags at their end, parsed once per widget or list item
style.lists: keyed by id, reconciled in place by the runtime
style.conditionals: a binding that swaps one node with an empty text node
style.events: one delegated click and input listener; handlers given to the controls in document order (an expando the listener reads)
style.derived: plain functions read by bindings; a summary's binding sits in each source's list; no memoization
style.build: Vite production build, no plugin, hidden source maps

style.architecture: The Elm Architecture: Tea.element, one Model record, one update, one view (markup)
style.components: one module per widget kind (Config, Model, Msg, update, view, replace); Main holds per-widget Config data
style.routing: one Msg constructor per widget wrapping its kind's Msg, plus Pushed for host events; Html.map in view
style.lists: keyed For (.id) for todo, filter, feed; positional For for toggles, tabs
style.conditional: case/if holes with an empty fragment
style.derived: computed in view (summary lines with interpolation, todo left, filter matches)
style.externalEvents: project platform layer Push.onPush (Sub.on over a window event), read with a schema declaration and derived codecs
style.inputs: controlled inputs; amount keeps its typed text beside its last valid number

attribution: source maps: node_modules → runtime; unmapped bundler output → tooling (counted with runtime); the adapter file → adapter (excluded); everything else → app. Brotli split: runtime = brotli(runtime+tooling); app = brotli(app JS) − runtime.
